name: FormField

base.note: Pure composition of Label + Input + Error text (no new color or radius decisions). Adopts rhythm and typography 1:1 from existing building blocks.

figmaNote: No dedicated Figma component set for FormField (scope decision, 2026-08-27; FormField is a pure code composition pattern of Label + Input + Error text).

props.name: label
props.description: Required. Text content of the <label>, linked to Input via htmlFor.

props.name: labelAction
props.description: Optional element placed to the right of the label, e.g. a Button variant="link".

props.name: error
props.description: Present = field is marked invalid. Internally sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the Input.

props.name: id
props.description: Optional. When omitted, FormField generates a stable ID via useId().

props.name: className
props.description: Applied to the outer wrapper (Label + Input + Error container), not the input element itself.

passthrough.note: All additional props (type, value, onChange, placeholder, required, autoComplete, etc.) are passed directly to the inner Input component.
